query: Users get Invalid credentials right after resetting their password
reference_answer: Flush the credential cache on all auth nodes and set the cache TTL back to 5 minutes in idp-config.yaml.

query: Login keeps redirecting back and forth with the identity provider
reference_answer: Change the session cookie from SameSite=Strict to SameSite=Lax with the Secure flag.

query: What authentication problems have we seen and how were they fixed?
reference_answer: Stale credential cache after password reset (flush cache, TTL 5 min); SSO redirect loop (SameSite=Lax cookie); MFA lockout after phone change (manager-verified bypass code, re-enroll, backup codes).

query: ETL load into the warehouse is too slow and times out
reference_answer: Switch from full refresh to incremental loading using the updated_at watermark and add an index on updated_at.

query: Intermittent 502 errors from the API at peak time
reference_answer: Set the application keep-alive timeout below the load balancer idle timeout (55s vs 60s).

query: SQL Server performance problems: high CPU and deadlocks
reference_answer: High CPU from parameter sniffing: OPTION (RECOMPILE) and a covering index. Deadlocks: consistent lock ordering, READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT, and retry with backoff for error 1205.

query: Customers aren't receiving our emails even though we sent them
reference_answer: Update SPF and DKIM DNS records to include the new mail relay IP range.

query: Duplicate patient rows with the same MRN after replaying messages
reference_answer: Change the ADT loader from INSERT to MERGE on facility_id and MRN, dedupe keeping the latest record, and add a unique constraint.

query: Our cloud query bill jumped a lot this month
reference_answer: Partition the large events table by date, cluster by user_id, and stop SELECT * by selecting only needed columns with a date filter.

query: Reporting issues: stale dashboards, failed exports, and reports going to the wrong people
reference_answer: Stale dashboard: schedule extract after ETL with a dependency trigger. Excel export out of memory: use CSV for large exports and raise server memory. Wrong recipients: fix mappings, sync from HR nightly, enable row-level security.

query: Service fails right after deploy and keeps restarting
reference_answer: Add the missing required environment variable to the Helm values file and redeploy.
